author: KEXP
description: Scranton, Pennsylvania's Tiger Jaw examine the passage of time through melodic and multi-layered rock ballads on their latest release 'Lost On You.' With host DJ Cheryl Waters, the group share a performance of "Head Is Like A Sinking Stone" and more.
title: Tigers Jaw performs "Head Is Like A Sinking Stone" & more Live on KEXP
